section: California property tax: state rules
label: Levied by
value: Counties collect the 1% general levy and apportion it to the local districts within the county
note: Property tax is levied locally; these are the rules the state sets. Each row has its own official source.
source_title: California Constitution, Article XIII A (Proposition 13), California Legislative Information

section: California property tax: state rules
label: State oversight
value: California State Board of Equalization (BOE), Property Tax Department
note: Oversees the 58 county assessors and assesses certain utility and railroad property directly.
source_title: California State Board of Equalization: Property Tax

section: California property tax: state rules
label: Maximum general property tax rate
note: Proposition 13 cap: 1% of full cash value; the assessed base may rise by no more than 2% a year (inflation) until a change in ownership or new construction.
source_title: California Constitution, Article XIII A (Proposition 13), California Legislative Information

section: California property tax: state rules

section: California real estate transfer tax
label: County documentary transfer tax
value: $0.55 per $500 of consideration or value (or fraction), when over $100
note: Counties may impose it by ordinance; value excludes liens or encumbrances remaining at the time of sale.
source_title: California Revenue and Taxation Code Section 11911 (Documentary Transfer Tax Act)

section: California real estate transfer tax
label: County documentary transfer tax rate
source_title: California Revenue and Taxation Code Section 11911 (Documentary Transfer Tax Act)

section: California real estate transfer tax
label: City documentary transfer tax
value: Up to half the county rate ($0.275 per $500), credited against the county tax
note: A city inside a county that levies the tax may add its own tax at one-half the county rate; the city tax is credited against the county tax.
source_title: California Revenue and Taxation Code Section 11911 (Documentary Transfer Tax Act)
